```{r}
library(highcharter)

chart_lang <- getOption("highcharter.lang")
chart_lang$decimalPoint <- ","
chart_lang$thousandsSep <- "."
chart_lang$rangeSelectorZoom <- ""
chart_lang$shortMonths <- c(
  "ene", "feb", "mar", "abr", "may", "jun",
  "jul", "ago", "sep", "oct", "nov", "dic"
)
options(highcharter.lang = chart_lang)

find_project_root <- function(path = getwd()) {
  path <- normalizePath(path, mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, "config", "series.yml"))) return(path)
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) stop("Could not locate the project root.")
    path <- parent
  }
}

project_root <- find_project_root()
series_dir <- file.path(project_root, "api", "v1", "series")
indicators_payload <- jsonlite::read_json(
  file.path(project_root, "api", "v1", "indicators.json"),
  simplifyVector = TRUE
)
indicators <- indicators_payload$indicators

read_series <- function(id) {
  payload <- jsonlite::read_json(
    file.path(series_dir, paste0(id, ".json")),
    simplifyVector = TRUE
  )
  data.frame(
    date = as.Date(payload$observations$date),
    value = as.numeric(payload$observations$value)
  )
}

format_percent <- function(x) scales::percent(x / 100, accuracy = 0.1, decimal.mark = ",")
format_number <- function(x) scales::number(x, accuracy = 0.01, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
format_currency <- function(x) scales::dollar(x, accuracy = 0.01, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")

make_chart <- function(
  id,
  label,
  formatter = format_number,
  value_suffix = "",
  value_decimals = 2,
  zero_line = FALSE
) {
  data <- read_series(id)
  data <- data[is.finite(data$value), , drop = FALSE]
  last_date <- max(data$date)
  first_date <- seq(last_date, by = "-5 years", length.out = 2L)[[2L]]
  visible <- data[data$date >= first_date, , drop = FALSE]
  latest <- tail(visible$value, 1L)
  plot_lines <- if (zero_line) {
    list(list(value = 0, color = "#c6a15b", width = 1, zIndex = 2))
  } else {
    list()
  }

  highcharter::hchart(
    visible,
    "line",
    highcharter::hcaes(x = date, y = value),
    name = label
  ) |>
    highcharter::hc_chart(
      backgroundColor = "transparent",
      zoomType = "x",
      spacing = c(8, 8, 4, 8)
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_title(
      text = formatter(latest),
      align = "center",
      verticalAlign = "top",
      y = 30,
      style = list(
        color = "#17242d",
        fontFamily = "IBM Plex Serif, Georgia, serif",
        fontSize = "34px",
        fontWeight = "500"
      )
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_subtitle(
      text = paste0(label, " · último dato: ", format(last_date, "%d-%m-%Y")),
      align = "center",
      y = 62,
      style = list(color = "#53636d", fontSize = "12px")
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_xAxis(
      type = "datetime",
      ordinal = FALSE,
      title = list(text = NULL),
      lineWidth = 0,
      tickWidth = 0,
      labels = list(style = list(color = "#53636d", fontSize = "11px"))
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_yAxis(
      title = list(text = ""),
      opposite = TRUE,
      gridLineColor = "#e7ebee",
      plotLines = plot_lines,
      labels = list(style = list(color = "#53636d", fontSize = "11px"))
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_plotOptions(
      series = list(
        animation = FALSE,
        connectNulls = TRUE,
        lineWidth = 2.5,
        marker = list(enabled = FALSE),
        states = list(hover = list(lineWidthPlus = 0))
      )
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_tooltip(
      shared = TRUE,
      valueDecimals = value_decimals,
      valueSuffix = value_suffix,
      xDateFormat = "%d %b %Y"
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_rangeSelector(
      selected = 1,
      inputEnabled = FALSE,
      buttonTheme = list(
        fill = "transparent",
        stroke = "#d8dee7",
        style = list(color = "#53636d", fontSize = "10px"),
        states = list(select = list(fill = "#eaf6fa", style = list(color = "#003b5c")))
      ),
      buttons = list(
        list(type = "ytd", text = "YTD"),
        list(type = "year", count = 1, text = "1a"),
        list(type = "year", count = 5, text = "5a")
      )
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_navigator(
      enabled = TRUE,
      height = 24,
      maskFill = "rgba(0, 59, 92, 0.08)",
      series = list(color = "#75bddb", lineWidth = 1)
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_scrollbar(enabled = FALSE) |>
    highcharter::hc_legend(enabled = FALSE) |>
    highcharter::hc_exporting(enabled = FALSE) |>
    highcharter::hc_credits(enabled = FALSE) |>
    highcharter::hc_colors("#003b5c") |>
    highcharter::hc_responsive(
      rules = list(
        list(
          condition = list(maxWidth = 360),
          chartOptions = list(
            chart = list(spacing = c(4, 4, 2, 4)),
            rangeSelector = list(enabled = FALSE),
            navigator = list(enabled = FALSE),
            xAxis = list(labels = list(enabled = FALSE), tickLength = 0),
            yAxis = list(
              labels = list(enabled = FALSE),
              gridLineWidth = 0,
              title = list(text = NULL)
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
updated_at <- as.POSIXct(
  indicators_payload$updated_at,
  format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ",
  tz = "UTC"
)
updated_label <- format(updated_at, "%d-%m-%Y · %H:%M UTC")

indicator_items <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(indicators)), function(index) {
  item <- indicators[index, , drop = FALSE]
  paste0(
    '<span class="navbar-indicator">',
    '<span>', htmltools::htmlEscape(item$name), '</span>',
    '<strong>', htmltools::htmlEscape(item$display_value), '</strong>',
    '<small>', htmltools::htmlEscape(item$period), '</small>',
    '</span>'
  )
}, character(1))

cat(
  '<header class="studio-hero">',
  '<p class="studio-eyebrow">Chile · panorama económico</p>',
  '<h1>Indicadores económicos</h1>',
  '<p>Una vista compacta de actividad, precios, mercado laboral, tasas y unidades de cuenta.</p>',
  '<small>Actualizado ', updated_label, '</small>',
  '</header>',
  '<div id="navbar-ticker-source" class="navbar-ticker" tabindex="0" role="region" ',
  'aria-label="Últimos indicadores. Toca o enfoca para pausar la cinta.">',
  '<div class="navbar-ticker-track">',
  '<div class="navbar-ticker-group">', paste(indicator_items, collapse = ""), '</div>',
  '<div class="navbar-ticker-group" aria-hidden="true">', paste(indicator_items, collapse = ""), '</div>',
  '</div></div>',
  '<script>',
  'document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {',
  '  var ticker = document.getElementById("navbar-ticker-source");',
  '  var links = document.querySelector(".quarto-dashboard-links");',
  '  if (ticker && links) links.before(ticker);',
  '});',
  'document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {',
  '  var ticker = event.target.closest(".navbar-ticker");',
  '  if (ticker) ticker.classList.toggle("is-paused");',
  '});',
  '</script>'
)
```
